name: Coder
description: Implements one dev sub-task of a Task — its group of Architect's spec, or its acceptance criteria — in the Task's workflow worktree via TDD, commits each step, and reports via the `atlas-outcome` block; the workflow pushes the branch and opens the one PR when the Task finishes.
summary: Implements one dev sub-task of a Task via TDD on the Task's branch.
